factories.name: new_list_inboxes_step
factories.description: List one page of the account's Hiver shared inboxes with their IDs, names, and email addresses, and the token of the next page.

inputSchema.description: ListInboxesInput selects one page of the account's shared inboxes.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of inboxes per page, from 10 to 100; zero uses DefaultPageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken is NextPageToken from the previous page, or empty for the first page.

factories.name: new_list_conversations_step
factories.description: List one page of up to 100 conversations of one shared inbox with their Hiver status, assignee, and tag IDs, and the token of the next page.

inputSchema.description: ListConversationsInput selects one page of a shared inbox's conversations. Hiver documents no status, assignee, or date filter for this list, so a Flow filters the returned page.

inboxId.description: InboxID is the Hiver shared inbox ID, as listInboxes returns it.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of conversations per page, from 10 to 100; zero uses DefaultPageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken is NextPageToken from the previous page, or empty for the first page.

factories.name: new_get_conversation_step
factories.description: Read one conversation of a shared inbox by Hiver conversation ID or Gmail thread ID, with its status, assignee, tag IDs, and message IDs.

inputSchema.description: GetConversationInput identifies one conversation of a shared inbox.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Hiver conversation ID or the shared mailbox user's Gmail thread ID.

inboxId.description: InboxID is the Hiver shared inbox ID, as listInboxes returns it.

factories.name: new_update_conversation_step
factories.description: Set the Hiver status or assignee of one conversation and apply or remove tags by name, then read the conversation back; a repeated attempt sends the same absolute change again.

inputSchema.description: UpdateConversationInput is one absolute change to a conversation. Empty fields are left unchanged; Hiver's API documents no way to unassign a conversation.

applyTagNames.description: ApplyTagNames are names of existing inbox tags to add; other tags stay. The connector matches a name exactly, then without regard to letter case; it never creates a tag.

assigneeEmail.description: AssigneeEmail assigns the conversation to the inbox user with this email, or is empty to keep the assignee. The connector first finds the user with GET /users/search, so an email that is not a user of the inbox selects providerRejected before any change.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Hiver conversation ID or the shared mailbox user's Gmail thread ID.

inboxId.description: InboxID is the Hiver shared inbox ID, as listInboxes returns it.

removeTagNames.description: RemoveTagNames are names of existing inbox tags to remove; other tags stay.

status.description: Status is the new Hiver status, or empty to keep it.

factories.name: new_add_note_step
factories.description: Add one internal note, visible only to Hiver users, to a conversation. The shared single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts can read its heartbeat checkpoint. Hiver documents no idempotency key or note read-back, so ambiguous sends remain uncertain.

inputSchema.description: AddNoteInput is one internal note to add to a conversation.

content.description: Content is the note body: plain text, emoji, or the safe subset of HTML Hiver renders. Only Hiver users see notes; the customer never receives them.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Hiver conversation ID or the shared mailbox user's Gmail thread ID.

inboxId.description: InboxID is the Hiver shared inbox ID, as listInboxes returns it.

factories.name: new_create_shared_draft_step
factories.description: Create one shared reply draft for a Hiver user to review and send. The shared single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts can read its heartbeat checkpoint. Hiver documents no idempotency key or draft read-back, so ambiguous sends remain uncertain.

inputSchema.description: CreateSharedDraftInput is one reply draft to one message of a conversation. Exactly one of HiverMessageID and GmailMessageID is required.

body.description: Body is the reply text Hiver places in the draft. Hiver's documentation does not say whether it renders markup, so send plain text unless a test in your account shows otherwise.

gmailMessageId.description: GmailMessageID is the shared mailbox user's Gmail message ID to reply to, as getConversation returns it, or the message's SMTP Message-ID header such as <abc123@mail.gmail.com>, which Hiver accepts as a fallback.

hiverMessageId.description: HiverMessageID is the Hiver message ID to reply to, as getConversation returns it.

inboxId.description: InboxID is the Hiver shared inbox ID, as listInboxes returns it.
